**Coaching Note:**

When your opponent's king moves to safety from a check, always scan for knight forks and back-rank patterns. Here, Qh4+ forces Kg1, and then Ne2 is a devastating fork—it attacks both f1 and g1, delivering checkmate because the king has no escape squares. Always calculate two moves ahead after forcing checks.
